collection.description: A child misses a friend who joined another Isolan community.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) misses a friend who joined another Isolan community.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult) says families sometimes move for work or belonging.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that moving does not mean friendship was false.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) saves a drawing of a favorite game.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) decides the keepsake makes them sad and puts it away.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) prefers to play quietly for a while.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) makes a new playmate without forgetting the old one.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) needs more time before meeting anyone new.
